title: Marcus D. Wiley: Rehab
overview: Ali Siddiq presents Marcus D. Wiley: REHAB, the powerful new full stand-up comedy special focused on fixing marriages, restoring relationships, and best practices for healthy love. This is the highly anticipated follow-up to Marcus’s breakout hit Marriage Is Major Surgery, which has over 5 million views and became one of the most-watched comedy specials of 2025.  In REHAB, Marcus D. Wiley delivers clean, hilarious, and faith-driven storytelling that blends Christian values, relationship wisdom, and stand-up comedy into one unforgettable experience. Known for his family-friendly humor, church-rooted perspective, and relatable marriage insight, Marcus uses comedy to address real-life relationship struggles, communication breakdowns, expectations, and emotional healing in a way that makes people laugh while helping them grow.
